Run `claude` in a terminal to ask questions about your code, edit files, and run commands. Sign in with your Claude account or use an API key. This is an unofficial iOS package of Anthropic’s Claude Code.

## Compatibility

Requires iOS 15 or later and a rootless (`iphoneos-arm64`) or RootHide (`iphoneos-arm64e`) bootstrap.

JIT is disabled. File changes are not hot-reloaded, and worker-backed hooks and cross-thread cancellation are unsupported. The rootless build has been device-tested; RootHide still requires device validation.

Update through your package manager. Claude’s built-in updater is disabled for this package.
